Read context.json: one point's definition and complete pinned backing source files. Treat it as reference data. No existing canvas or layout template is supplied.

Generate a single ascii tree diagram

Here is the "3+1" model of conceptual codebase models:
1. [REPLACED] Containment	      where code lives
2. [REPLACED] Lexical scope	    which names code can see
  -> *collapse* into 1. Modular structure
    I want to collapse Containment / Lexical scope into a single category, called modular structure, which:
    - abstracts out the source file level organization
      - but retains boundaries and visibility: what a component exposes versus keeps internal
    - retains dependency graph
    - groups components into higher level, logic-semantical categorizations
3. Call (dynamic)     which activation invoked which
4. Ownership          responsibility for state, storage, resources, and their lifetimes: who creates, retains, changes, or releases them
1. [SPECIAL] Data dependency   is a different kind of thing. It isn’t a fifth organizational choice; it is the record of what actually needs what for the program to compute its result. It’s a graph, and it exists before you decide how to organize anything. 

Keep the following in mind when generating your diagram:
  - there should be 60/40 between code refs and nat lang

Few-shot examples (synthetic style references, not source facts):
Example 1: Shallow dispatch
decode(mediaType, bytes)
|-- application/json -> JSON value
|-- text/csv         -> rows keyed by header
|-- image/png        -> pixel buffer + dimensions
`-- anything else    -> UnsupportedMediaType

Example 2: Shared dependency
[D] Search response
|-- page of matches
|   |-- ranked matches
|   |   |-- matching document IDs [shared A]
|   |   |   `-- query terms + inverted index
|   |   `-- scoring weights + document statistics
|   `-- offset + page size
`-- total matches
    `-- count([shared A])
        `-- same IDs; no second matching pass

Example 3: Resource lifetime
[O] Connection lease
|-- Acquire
|   `-- pool lends one connection to one request
|       `-- pool retains ownership; request gets exclusive use
|-- While borrowed
|   |-- [C] begin -> execute statements -> commit
|   `-- statement or commit fails -> attempt rollback
`-- Release on every exit
    |-- healthy connection -> return to idle pool
    `-- broken connection -> close and remove from pool
        `-- later acquisition may create a replacement

Example 4: Bounded retry
[C] Deliver webhook                         at most 3 attempts
`-- POST event with stable delivery ID
    |-- 2xx -> mark delivered
    |-- permanent rejection -> mark failed
    `-- timeout / temporary rejection
        |-- attempts remain
        |   `-- wait with backoff -> retry POST above
        |       `-- receiver deduplicates by delivery ID
        `-- exhausted -> dead-letter queue

Example 5: Module boundary
[M] Template engine
|-- Public contract
|   |-- compile(text): Template
|   `-- render(template, bindings): text
|-- Internal machinery
|   |-- parser -> syntax tree
|   |-- compiler -> rendering instructions
|   `-- interpreter
|       `-- [D] instructions + bindings -> output text
`-- Extension boundary
    `-- registered formatters: value -> text
        `-- interpreter calls them; parser stays private

Example 6: Event fan-out
DocumentSaved(documentId, revision)
|-- Search subscriber -> enqueue reindex
|-- Preview subscriber -> invalidate cached thumbnail
`-- Audit subscriber -> append revision record

Subscribers run independently; branch order is not execution order.
Each subscriber handles its own retry.

Use the examples as a varied pool of representational choices. Let the supplied evidence determine depth, branching, density, and relationship types; do not copy their domain facts, exact shapes, counts, or require every tag.

Return JSON matching output-schema.json: {ascii}. Return exactly one ASCII tree with one root, printable ASCII characters, spaces and LF newlines. No Markdown fences or surrounding prose. The complete tree must fit within 20000 characters. Do not add separate side diagrams.

[O] Browser Workspace Ownership -- many CanvasSession lifetimes, one shared persistence pipeline
|-- [O] MappingWorkspacePage composes and releases the live workspace
|   |-- new CanvasWorkspace(canvasHistory)
|   |   |-- store.drafts[id]: CanvasDraft = metadata + stable session handle
|   |   |-- setDrafts(seed) -> new CanvasSession(...) -> new MappingDocumentController(...)
|   |   |   `-- controllers.set(id, session.controller): commands can address inactive canvases
|   |   |-- Existing session retained -> updateBaseline(draft)
|   |   |   `-- Metadata changes need not recreate the editing context
|   |   `-- Session replaced or draft removed
|   |       `-- Unsubscribe -> controllers.delete(id) -> old.session.dispose()
|   |           `-- cursorCopy.clear(); unsubscribe from controller; clear commitListeners
|   |-- mountedDocuments remembers canvases that have become active
|   |   `-- MappingEditorCanvas(session={draft.session}) stays mounted when another canvas opens
|   |       |-- hidden / enabled select the visible, interactive editor
|   |       `-- Native Editor owns live geometry and undo navigation
|   |           `-- Pointer/camera samples do not publish CanvasSession application state
|   |-- injectedStorage ?? new WorkspaceStorage()
|   |   |-- WorkspaceStorage owns records: RecordStorage and one lazily created Worker
|   |   |-- requests[id] retains resolve/reject callbacks until the worker replies
|   |   `-- WorkspacePersistence(workspace, records, projectId, viewState)
|   |       `-- Owns workspace.onPersist and view.subscribe subscriptions
|   `-- Page cleanup
|       |-- workspace.dispose() -> unsubscribe and dispose every retained session
|       |-- WorkspacePersistence.dispose() -> detach persistence subscriptions
|       |-- viewState.flush() -> viewState.dispose()
|       `-- Locally created storage: attempt flush(), then dispose() even if flush fails
|           |-- RecordStorage.dispose(): cancel timer and clear listeners
|           |-- WorkspaceStorage.dispose(): terminate worker and reject outstanding requests
|           `-- Injected storage is not disposed by the page; abrupt tab exit cannot guarantee flush
|-- [M] Semantic boundaries -- public contracts and internal machinery
|   |-- Editing registry: CanvasWorkspace -> CanvasSession -> MappingDocumentController
|   |   |-- CanvasWorkspace exposes setDrafts(), copyDocument(), controllers, onPersist()
|   |   |-- store / changes / dirtyScenes expose readable subscriptions
|   |   `-- Internal subscriptions bind each registered ID to its session lifetime
|   |-- Session read boundary: readable(store)
|   |   |-- Public getState(), getInitialState(), subscribe(); internal stores retain setState()
|   |   |-- document     -> document consumers, including search and explorer
|   |   |-- presentation -> display + diagramViews
|   |   |-- selection    -> selected items
|   |   |-- controls     -> interaction controls
|   |   |-- geometry     -> endpointBounds + cell + version
|   |   `-- status       -> isDirty + sceneDirty + canUndo + canRedo
|   |       `-- Mutations use session.controller; consumers subscribe to the slice they need
|   |-- Persistence translation: WorkspacePersistence -> RecordStorage
|   |   |-- Public sync(), update(), setPaused(), dispose()
|   |   `-- Private cursors / known / syncView() / submit(): translate live owners into records
|   `-- Storage transport: RecordStorage -> RecordTransport.write(WorkspaceBatch)
|       |-- RecordStorage owns cache, pending changes, flight, revision and scheduling
|       |-- WorkspaceStorage supplies write: batch => request({ type: 'write', batch })
|       `-- Worker owns normalization, JSON encoding and fetch()
|           `-- HTTP boundary: /api/mapping/workspace/records
|-- [C] A committed edit reaches persistence without broadcasting every gesture
|   |-- MappingDocumentController subscription -> CanvasSession reads next snapshot
|   |   |-- Publish changed presentation / selection / controls / geometry slices
|   |   |-- publishStatus(next); publish document only when its reference changes
|   |   |   `-- session.document subscription refreshes the registry entry for document consumers
|   |   `-- next.canvasRevisionId != previous.canvasRevisionId -> commitListeners
|   |       `-- CanvasWorkspace: changed() -> persist([id])
|   |           `-- WorkspacePersistence.sync([id]) -> submit(changes) -> storage.batch(changes)
|   |-- Other persistence triggers join the same RecordStorage
|   |   |-- setDrafts(): changed persisted metadata, added/replaced session, or removed draft
|   |   |-- view.subscribe(id) -> syncView(id): captured display and camera records
|   |   `-- update(activeDocumentId, transfers): workspace index record
|   |-- RecordStorage.batch(changes)
|   |   |-- same(cached, incoming) -> skip unchanged values
|   |   |-- cache updates immediately; pending.set(key, change) keeps the latest change per key
|   |   `-- schedule(): default 150 ms debounce, capped by 1000 ms since first pending change
|   |-- timer or flush() -> pump()
|   |   |-- running exists -> reuse its Promise; writes remain serialized
|   |   `-- No flight -> freeze pending into WorkspaceBatch
|   |       |-- requestId = crypto.randomUUID(); expectedRevision = current revision
|   |       |-- changes = pending.values(); flight.sequence = current sequence
|   |       `-- Clear pending; later edits accumulate separately from this flight
|   `-- transport.write(flight.batch) -> worker message -> POST records endpoint
|       |-- Worker bodies[requestId] caches the normalized JSON request body
|       |-- Acknowledged success
|       |   |-- Worker updates known records and removes the cached body
|       |   `-- RecordStorage updates revision / persisted; clears flight / error / failures
|       |       `-- Schedule any pending changes accumulated during the write
|       |-- Network failure or uncertain server response
|       |   |-- Retain flight: same requestId, expectedRevision and changes on retry
|       |   |-- Worker retains cached body when the outcome is uncertain
|       |   `-- Automatic retry uses exponential backoff capped at 30 seconds
|       `-- REJECTED:, VERSION_CONFLICT or REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|           `-- schedule() stops automatic retries; storage.status exposes the error
|-- [C] Explicit workspace transactions publish UI state after acknowledgement
|   |-- transfer() -> persistence.setPaused(true) -> prepare candidate workspace
|   |   `-- publishTransfer(candidate) -> await storage.save(candidate)
|   |       |-- load() -> records.flush() -> project(candidate) -> records.commit(changes)
|   |       `-- Success -> installWorkspace(candidate): replace sessions and advance workspaceEpoch
|   |-- projectDiagrams() -> await storage.saveDocument(child, index, true)
|   |   `-- Success -> setDrafts(...current, child): retain existing sessions and editors
|   |-- RecordStorage.commit(changes)
|   |   |-- Flush earlier writes -> capture cache baseline -> batch(changes) -> flush()
|   |   |-- REJECTED: -> restore cache baseline; clear pending/flight; throw
|   |   |   `-- A definitively rejected operation must not be published later
|   |   `-- Other failures -> wait 500 ms -> retry flush() with the same flight
|   |       `-- Do not allow a new write to overtake an ambiguous transaction
|   `-- workspaceBusy becomes false -> update(activeId, transfers) -> sync()
|       `-- Resume incremental persistence against the installed live workspace
`-- [D] What the persisted result and status actually need -- dependency edges, not ownership
    |-- workspace record <- projectId + draft IDs + activeDocumentId + transfers
    |   `-- index() falls back to the first draft ID when activeDocumentId is absent or invalid
    |-- Per-document metadata / baseline <- CanvasDraft + controller.getSnapshot().version
    |   `-- name, type, repositoryId, hidden, savedName, savedScene, savedEdges, revisionId
    |-- historyChanges(id, delta) <- controller.persistenceChanges(cursors.get(session))
    |   |-- cursors: WeakMap<CanvasSession, sequence>; progress belongs to a runtime session
    |   |-- First sync removes obsolete revision/checkpoint keys under documentPrefix(id)
    |   |-- Existing immutable revisions and identical checkpoint deltas can be skipped
    |   `-- Removed draft -> delete every stored key under documentPrefix(id)
    |-- canvasViewChanges(id, canvas) <- controller canvas + view.captureDisplay(id, display)
    |   |-- viewport <- view.captureCamera(id, draft.viewport)
    |   `-- submit(): deduplicate keys and omit already cached content-addressed /item/ records
    |       `-- History and view records can reuse the same immutable items
    |-- RecordStorage.status.pending <- sequence > persisted
    |   `-- Transport acknowledgement advances persisted; an updated cache alone does not
    `-- CanvasSession.statusOf(snapshot)
        |-- sceneDirty <- stateKey(current scene) != stateKey(savedScene)
        |-- isDirty <- sceneDirty OR changed edges OR name != savedName
        |-- canUndo / canRedo <- controller snapshot
        `-- updateBaseline() uses the captured save acknowledgement
            `-- Later edits can remain dirty even after an earlier save succeeds

Immutable Diagram Revisions -- shared content boundary for canvas, persistence, and agents
|-- [M] Modular structure -- contracts, internals, and dependencies
|   |-- Diagram + DiagramRevision: content travels as one revision
|   |   |-- Diagram.diagramId = stable service identity; Diagram.id = local content key
|   |   |-- Diagram.revisionId = immutable revision identity; revision = numeric content revision
|   |   |-- content + sourceContext + highlights? + jumps?
|   |   `-- DiagramRevision = { id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs }
|   |-- Domain operations: createDiagram / reviseDiagram / deriveDiagram
|   |   |-- Return DiagramRevisionResult; persistence and publication are explicit
|   |   `-- Depend on DiagramRevisionEditor -> constructDiagram / patchDiagramRanges
|   |-- DiagramRevisionEditor: context-sensitive editing and reading
|   |   |-- resolve / prepareCreate / prepareEdit / merge
|   |   |-- private revision(): bindings(contextId)[diagramId] -> revisions[id]
|   |   `-- private correspondence(): validates explicit logical-node continuity
|   |-- Storage API: get / list / import / retain DiagramRevision
|   |   |-- createStoredDiagram / reviseStoredDiagram / deriveStoredDiagram
|   |   |-- submitStoredDiagramEdit -> submitDiagramEdit -> domain operations
|   |   `-- Internal diagramRevisions: RevisionRegistry owns runtime records
|   |-- Parsing boundary: buildDiagramContent + diagramContentNodes
|   |   `-- constructDiagram builds content; validateDiagram rebuilds it for comparison
|   `-- Canvas boundary: history supplies context bindings
|       `-- Placement stays outside Diagram; merge handles revision bindings only
|-- [C] Calls -- issuing and editing a revision
|   |-- createDiagram(input)
|   |   `-- prepareCreate(input) -> constructDiagram(input) -> issueDiagramRevision(prepared)
|   |       |-- constructDiagram: buildDiagramContent -> clone attached data -> validateDiagram
|   |       `-- issueDiagramRevision: assign nodeRefs -> deepFreeze(record) -> validateDiagram
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   |   `-- prepareEdit('edit', base.diagram.id, edit)
|   |       |-- source-mappings
|   |       |   `-- Check expectedContentHash -> clone mappings/evidence -> validateDiagram
|   |       |-- patch / patches
|   |       |   |-- patchDiagramRanges -> optional correspondence + highlight rebasing
|   |       |   `-- patches.retainMappings -> retainSourceMappings; otherwise use supplied mappings
|   |       |-- replace
|   |       |   |-- constructDiagram(..., revision: before.revision + 1)
|   |       |   `-- correspondence -> rebase jumps/highlights -> optionally retain mappings
|   |       |-- jumps / highlights -> validate supplied annotations
|   |       `-- Return prepared edit
|   |           |-- prepared.diagram === base.diagram -> return base revision
|   |           `-- Otherwise preserve diagramId, mint revisionId -> issueDiagramRevision(..., base)
|   |-- submitDiagramEdit(request, raw, base, correspondence?)
|   |   |-- Reject mismatched base revision or diagram; new diagrams cannot supply replacementRanges
|   |   |-- context = base.diagram || request.context.diagram || '[New diagram]' placeholder
|   |   |-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit(context, raw, base?.nodeRefs, request.sourceMappings)
|   |   |-- base + requested edit ranges -> scopedReplacements
|   |   |   |-- Reject structureKind change; produce patches + outputRanges
|   |   |   |-- Shift mappings outside replaced ranges; filter generated mappings into outputRanges
|   |   |   `-- reviseDiagram(kind: 'patches', retainMappings: !request.sourceMappings)
|   |   |-- Otherwise request.baseRevisionId -> reviseDiagram(kind: 'replace')
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> createDiagram(..., revision: 0)
|   `-- merge(baseline, current, proposed)
|       |-- Any baseline/current binding differs -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|       `-- Otherwise return copy of proposed; automatic three-way merge is absent
|-- [O] Ownership -- creation, retention, exposure, and lifetime
|   |-- issueDiagramRevision owns issuance of immutable records
|   |   |-- deepFreeze({ id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs })
|   |   `-- Edits produce successor records; parentId points to base.id
|   |-- retainDiagramRevision(result)
|   |   `-- importDiagramRevision(result.revision) -> diagramRevisions.register -> get
|   |       |-- Import requires a nonempty, unique logical ref for each parsed node
|   |       `-- Return result with the registry's retained diagram and revision
|   |-- RevisionRegistry.install(record, deferred)
|   |   |-- Require record.id === diagram.revisionId and matching diagramId
|   |   |-- Existing id
|   |   |   |-- Same JSON.stringify(record) signature -> reuse prior record
|   |   |   `-- Different signature -> 'Diagram revision is immutable'
|   |   `-- New id -> deepFreeze(structuredClone(record))
|   |       `-- Private records + signatures retain the snapshot independently of caller input
|   |-- restore(record) -> install(record, true)
|   |   |-- pendingValidation retains id; older records remain addressable before parsing
|   |   `-- First get(id) validates diagram + nodeRefs, then removes pending marker
|   |-- resolve(contextId, diagramId) -> structuredClone(DiagramView)
|   |   |-- Remap node id/parentId/childIds through nodeRefs
|   |   `-- Return active jumps with logical source refs; immutable payload is not exposed here
|   |-- getDiagramRevision -> frozen record; listDiagramRevisions -> frozen identity summaries
|   `-- Durable adapters must flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
|       `-- No removal or eviction operation appears in the supplied registry
`-- [D] Data dependency -- what each result needs, across the boundaries above
    |-- Valid Diagram.content
    |   |-- content.ascii + id:revision + structure.kind + contentParserVersion(structure)
    |   |   `-- buildDiagramContent(...) -> canonical content
    |   `-- JSON.stringify(content) must equal JSON.stringify(canonical)
    |-- Source evidence attached to the same ASCII
    |   |-- sourceContext.contentHash must equal asciiSha256(content.ascii)
    |   |-- mapping.entityId -> evidence[entityId]
    |   |   `-- mapping.sourceRangeIndex -> sourceRanges[index]
    |   |       |-- Optional mapping.sourceRangeId must match range.id
    |   |       `-- Relative path + valid line bounds + matching originalLines count
    |   |-- Optional binding: sourceId + repositoryIdentity + corpus + domainProfileId
    |   |   `-- Validate corpus/profile pairing; evidence sourceId must agree when both are present
    |   `-- diagramSource -> queryDiagramSourceContext
    |       `-- entries / forSelection / search join mapping + entity + range + binding
    |-- Successor nodeRefs: parsed node id -> persistent logical ref
    |   |-- correspondingNodes(before, after)
    |   |   |-- Requires identical ASCII and structure kind
    |   |   `-- Match exact line + columns + label; heuristic similarity establishes no identity
    |   |-- nodeCorrespondence[logicalRef] = output line
    |   |   |-- Requires an old ref and exactly one output node on an integer line
    |   |   `-- Reject conflicts with inferred continuity or multiple refs claiming one node
    |   `-- issueDiagramRevision uses reverse(prepared.nodeIds)
    |       `-- Explicit identity override || inherited base.nodeRefs[old] || fresh node UUID
    |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
    |   |-- sources must share base.diagramId; their nodeRefs form the allowed ref set
    |   |-- Each refs[ref] must select exactly one output node with no duplicate target
    |   `-- Validated identities override issuance defaults; parent remains base.id
    `-- Reading a context-selected view
        `-- bindings(contextId)[diagramId] + revisions + diagram.content + nodeRefs
